preconditions.description: The input x must be a string.
The input string x must contain only alphabetic characters.
The input string x must not be empty.

postconditions.description: The output string must have the same length as the input string.
The output string must be the result of transforming each word in the input string according to the specified rules.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == x[-i-1] for i in range(len(x)//2))
postconditions.description: The first half of the output string must be the reverse of the first half of the input string.
